portal_hypertension.title: Impact of adding statins to non-selective beta-blockers in cirrhosis with portal hypertension: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
portal_hypertension.authors: Wu Q, Yang Y, Wu Q
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 95）。核心观点：尽管使用非选择性β受体阻滞剂（NSBB），肝硬化和门脉高压（PH）患者仍然面临很大的死亡风险。 临床提示：他汀类药物可以改善肝内微循环，并可能补充 NSBB 效应。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Despite non-selective beta-blockers (NSBBs), patients with cirrhosis and portal hypertension (PH) remain at substantial risk of death. Statins may improve intrahepatic microcirculation and potentially complement NSBB effects. We searched PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, Cochrane Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov from inception to October 2025 for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing NSBB-based therapy plus statins versus NSBB-based therapy alone. Rare events were synthesized using fixed-effect Peto odds ratios; other outcomes were pooled with random-effects models, with prediction intervals (PI) reported. portal_hypertension.title: Crosstalk between TFF2(+) HCC cells and regulatory T cells drives hepatocellular carcinoma prometastatic niche formation and portal vein tumor thrombosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Shi S, Li J, Zhang M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：门静脉肿瘤血栓形成（PVTT）是促进肝内播散、诱发门静脉高压、恶化肝细胞癌（HCC）预后的关键事件，但其形成机制仍知之甚少。 临床提示：通过分析 5 名患有 PVTT 的 HCC 患者的 15 个单细胞 RNA 测序样本，在肝细胞癌中鉴定出 TFF2 + HCC 细胞。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal vein tumor thrombosis (PVTT) is a critical event that promotes intrahepatic dissemination, induces portal hypertension, and worsens the prognosis of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet its formation mechanism remains poorly understood. TFF2 + HCC cells were identified in hepatocellular carcinoma by analyzing 15 single-cell RNA sequencing samples from 5 HCC patients with PVTT. The stemness and invasive characteristics of these cells were then assessed via bioinformatic analysis of public HCC cohorts and experimental validation. portal_hypertension.title: Efficacy and Safety of Statins in Patients with Liver Cirrhosis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials with Trial Sequential Analysis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Deng H, Wang R, Yin Y
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：最近的证据表明他汀类药物由于其多效性而对肝硬化有益。 临床提示：肝硬化是全球健康负担，发病率和死亡率很高。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver cirrhosis is a global health burden with high morbidity and mortality. Recent evidence suggests the benefits of statins in liver cirrhosis due to its pleiotropic effects. This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to evaluate the efficacy and safety of statins in patients with liver cirrhosis. PubMed, EMBASE, and Cochrane Library databases were systematically searched to identify all relevant randomized controlled trials (RCTs) regarding use of statins in cirrhosis.
